title: SRD 5.1 importer: subclass parser
description:
Per ADR 0009, parse SRD 5.1 subclasses into `subclass` records (kind added by loreweaver-0m9.5.16). Mirror the parser/emit/index/test structure of the spell + class parsers under packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/.

Each subclass record links to its parent base class via data.parentClass (the parent class record's key, produced by loreweaver-0m9.5.2). Provenance-tagged per ADR 0007 (extract from the vendored PDF, do not author from model knowledge). Manifest description must include 'subclass' in Included record kinds.

Depends on: 0m9.5.16 (subclass kind) and 0m9.5.2 (base class records + parser scaffolding/section detection).
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every SRD 5.1 subclass and links it to its parent class key.
- Records satisfy the subclass kindSchema.
- Manifest 'Included record kinds' lists 'subclass'.
- Unit tests cover at least one martial (Champion) and one caster (a cleric domain or wizard school) subclass.
close_reason: Implemented SRD 5.1 subclass parser (parseSubclasses.ts) + emit/index/cli wiring + tests + README. PR #116 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/116) open for review. Granted-feature references deferred to 0m9.5.18.
